title: Pomer & Boccia Professional
description:
Pomer & Boccia, is a well established Ontario law firm that has extensive experience in numerous areas of law. We have had a successful history for guiding business decisions in a straight forward, no nonsense way of guiding our clients to profitable outcomes.

Pomer & Boccia's lawyers are well experienced in all facets of business, taking charge in the courtroom or negotiating win-win scenarios in the boardroom. Our lawyers are very skilled at the art of business law by focusing on solving potential problems while securing positive business opportunities.
